source.title: How A Fruit Became A Toilet

transcript: Most people don't know this, but the dirtiest thing you can have in your bathroom is a fruit. Luffas are in the same plant family as cucumbers. They grow in a vine as a gourd, and when you dry them out, they turn into these natural sponges. And these fibers can absorb and trap almost anything that they touch. For centuries, this was the greatest bathing tool ever created. So while some people would eat it, others would turn it into this. But the same thing that makes it the best tool makes it the worst. That actually doesn't feel nice at all. Every time you use one of these, dead skin cells get trapped in these fibers. In 1994, scientists discovered that bacterial growth happens overnight on luffas. So luffas can grow more bacteria than a public toilet. So now every time you use it, you're scrubbing that bacteria back onto your skin. You spent centuries cleaning people, only to become the dirtiest thing that ever touched them. Which is pretty insane.
